sys_script_include.description: Central server-side orchestrator for the IncentIQ Smart Compensation Advisor. Handles the full request lifecycle: access gate, kill switch, input validation, per-user rate limiting, context building, PII/financial masking for external LLMs, prompt assembly with anti-injection guards, LLM invocation via the Generative AI Controller, response rehydration, and audit/failure logging. Single entry point (sendMessage) called by the advisor widget.
sys_script_include.name: IncentIQChatOrchestrator
